name: Horse

text.trigger: A player moves a survivor who is not exiled.
text.vignette: A starved horse picks its way down an alley with its ribs showing, and stops to regard you with the calm of something that has seen worse. You could take it with you or turn it into dinner.

options.keep-the-horse: Take it along: this card goes on the moved survivor, who never rolls exposure when moving again. While that survivor is not exiled, the colony pays 1 extra food at the pay-food step.
options.butcher-the-horse: Sorry, old girl. 3 food is added to the supply.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #39; The extra food ends if the rider dies or is exiled.
